subject: Security exhibit / audit access: proposed evidence lifecycle & contract governance
messages:
From: Michelle Nguyen <michelle.nguyen@clearviewhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit & pen test window questions (ClearView)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — ClearView Legal asked us to confirm a couple of items in the security exhibit before we sign the order form:

- SOC 2 coverage: we need confirmation that Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and the date range covered.
- Pen test language: our security team prefers a 30-day notice for scheduled pen tests and a summary report shared with us. Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept notice + summary only, or do you expect additional access?
- Audit access: we want clarity about on-site inspections vs evidence exports (audit right scope). Preferation: evidence exports + controlled remote access.
- Evidence cadence: we asked for a lightweight monthly evidence push for a subset of items (logs, retention confirmation). Is that feasible?

Can you route to legal and security and share the exhibit you plan to attach to the MSA/order form? We are aiming to have legal sign-off the week of Mar 27.

Thanks,
Michelle Nguyen
Sr. Security Program Manager, ClearView Health
attachments: requested_security_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Nguyen <michelle.nguyen@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit & pen test window questions (ClearView)

Hi Michelle — appreciate the clear list. Looping in Legal (Laura), Security (Marissa) and your account lead (Ben) so we can align on the exact exhibit language and an evidence cadence that meets your needs. High-level responses below; we’ll follow up with proposed redlines by EOD:  

- SOC 2: Redwood will provide a SOC 2 Type II report covering the 12-month period immediately prior to signing; we will attach a copy to the exhibit where permissible.
- Pen tests: We typically require 30 days' notice for scheduled vendor-initiated pen tests. We can provide a redacted summary report shared via secure link; production access is limited and controlled through our staging environment for vendor tests.
- Audit access: Our standard is remote evidence export (encrypted bundle) plus scoped remote session for discussion with our security team. On-site access is not required and generally restricted.
- Evidence cadence: We can run a monthly evidence bundle for a defined checklist and a quarterly deeper handoff for SOC-related items.

Action items: Laura will propose precise redline language for the exhibit; Marissa will propose the evidence cadence and owners; I’ll follow up with a mutual action plan and dates. Can your team do a 30-minute sync next Tue (Mar 20) to finalize?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: ClearView ask — evidence owners + cadence proposal

Laura / team — short internal note to capture proposed approach before we send formal redlines:  

1) Evidence lifecycle proposal (suggested):
   - Monthly light bundle (logs summary, retention confirmation, patching attestations) pushed to ClearView via secure S3 link on the 5th of each month.
   - Quarterly bundle aligned with SOC 2 scope (attestations, control reports) on the 15th of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct.
   - Ad-hoc exports for legal/audit with 3 business day SLA for standard items.

2) Pen test handling:
   - Customer will provide 30 days' notice for a planned pen test.
   - Redwood will accept a summary report (redacted) and a 1-hour review session; production network access is restricted to our staging environment and requires an MOU.

3) Audit access & redlines that matter to procurement:
   - No perpetual on-site access; access is limited to encrypted evidence bundles + scoped remote sessions.
   - Redwood will not allow customer control-plane access or exfiltration of raw system-level logs beyond the bundle.

I’ll draft the redline file with tracked changes and the evidence_ownership_calendar.csv that maps owners and delivery dates. Laura, if you can include the minimal legal phrasing for audit right scope (auditor vs legal rep, notice windows, confidentiality carveouts) that would be great.

-Marissa
Director, Security Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Mar 2028 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: internal: ClearView ask — legal redlines for security exhibit

Team — attached is the redline I plan to send back to ClearView. Key legal points I’ve incorporated:  

- SOC 2: insert clause that Redwood will provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering the prior 12 months and will update upon each new attestation. Add confidentiality protections for SOC artifacts.
- Pen tests: proposed language: "Customer shall provide at least thirty (30) days' advance notice for any third-party security testing; Redwood will make available a redacted test summary and may require testing to be performed in a supported staging environment under a mutually agreed MOU."
- Audit rights: limit scope to evidence exports and remote interviews; require non-disclosure agreements for any external auditors; prohibit exfiltration of raw system artifacts beyond defined bundles.
- Timing & remedies: limit remediation obligations to commercially reasonable efforts and allow 30 days to remediate material findings.

Attachments included: security_exhibit_redlines_20280316.docx (tracked changes) — I kept the language conservative to avoid opening broad inspection rights. Also adding an evidence calendar for operational owners.

I recommend the following outreach plan:
  - Send redlines + evidence calendar to ClearView legal and procurement.
  - Set up a Tue Mar 20 slot for a quick 30-min alignment call (Karthik to propose times).
  - If procurement pushes for on-site review, escalate to me and we’ll propose a scoped MOU and a separate professional services engagement.

-Laur a Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: security_exhibit_redlines_20280316.docx (docx)
